lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.bar: Two bars, stated together because Japan's convention and this name's wire coverage differ. (1) The company's own FY2027 range, given with the 2026-06-25 FY2026 決算短信: revenue +6.0% to +10.0% and EPS ¥525.00-¥540.00 (vs ¥495.97 actual FY2026) — https://note.com/yamashantoushi/n/nfe6baad90538 and the filing itself at https://finance-frontend-pc-dist.west.edge.storage-yahoo.jp/disclosure/20260625/20260624579200.pdf . (2) The number the 決算速報 wires lead with: IFIS 株予報 quarterly consensus, Q1 経常利益 ¥23,100M, full-year ¥101,125M — https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=4716 (read 2026-09-18). Q1 FY2026 経常 was approximately ¥21,500M (OP ¥21,128M, from the quarterly table at https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/4716/finance/ ), so the Q1 bar is roughly +7.4% YoY.
hunter_view.positioning_check: JPX 空売り残高報告 register as of 2026-09-18 carries NO disclosed short position in 4716 at or above the 0.5% threshold (short_ratio 0.0%, zero disclosed sellers) — https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html . 信用倍率 8.92 (margin longs 8.9x margin shorts), i.e. leveraged retail length and effectively no short base. There is no single-stock option market and therefore no skew to read. Implication: no squeeze fuel on a good print, and margin longs to liquidate on a bad one — the positioning is asymmetric to the downside, which is the same direction as my findings. Daily turnover ¥1.89bn median (20d) so liquidity is not a constraint. TSE daily price band at ¥9,346 is ±¥1,500 (~16%), far outside my sizing.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: It cuts against the tape but not against the baseline's arithmetic: the 20-day run-up of -0.42% makes this look like a name with no directional content, when in fact the last five sessions are +4.4% on a parent read-through, and the positioning lean (-0.454, driven by the 信用倍率 margin overhang with zero disclosed shorts) points the same way I do.

findings.finding: The quarter's own consensus bar (経常利益 ¥23,100M, +7.4% YoY) and the full-year one behind it (OP ¥100,389M, +11.8%) both require an operating-margin reversal that this company's disclosed mix shift argues against: FY2026 delivered revenue +8.2% but OP only +3.4%, gross margin 46.1%->45.0% and implied operating expenses +11.2%, because cloud went from 23.5% to 29.2% of revenue (+34.3%) while the high-margin software licence line fell 2.1% and support grew only 1.1% despite an 8% annual price increase.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the line the name is repeatedly sold on. Last year's same quarter (Q1 FY2026, printed late September 2025) missed EPS by 2.8% and the baseline's cadence window records -6.16%. The FY2026 print on 2026-06-25 reported record revenue and cloud +34.3% but 経常 ¥91,373M against an IFIS consensus of ¥93,100M (-1.9%) and the stock closed 2026-06-26 at ¥8,088 against ¥8,223, -1.64%. The Q3 print on 2026-03-24 was also sold (株価反落, baseline -4.37% on 03-25). Four consecutive prints, four negative reactions.

findings.finding: 4716 has rallied +4.4% in the five sessions into the print (¥8,954 close on 2026-09-10 to ¥9,346 on 2026-09-17, with a single +4.09% day on 09-14 that has no company-specific disclosure behind it), tracking the US parent's 2026-09-10 Q1 FY2027 blowout — revenue $19.35bn vs $19.14bn, OCI +121%, RPO $664bn — none of which reaches 日本オラクル's P&L, since 4716's cloud line is ¥83bn of domestic OCI/SaaS and it books none of the hyperscale AI backlog; ORCL itself closed lower on its own beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The press attributes 4716's moves to the parent's tape in both directions — the June 2026 sell-off was explained partly by ORCL's own decline. The last time the market held 4716 as an AI proxy it de-rated from ¥17,875 (June 2025) to below ¥8,100 by late June 2026, roughly -55%, without a single quarter in which 4716's own revenue growth fell below +7%. The proxy trade has unwound violently before; the last four prints, which is when the domestic P&L is actually shown, were all sold.

outside_window.finding: SoftBank's Oracle Alloy sovereign cloud 'Cloud PF Type A' opens its west-Japan datacentre region in October 2026, and NTT Data's Alloy-based OpenCanvas opens its west-Japan region by March 2027; both are domestic Alloy deployments that should add to 4716's cloud line, but the capacity comes online after this print.

The file's open question 1 ('does the 進捗率 beat everything else?') made me state the company's own FY2027 range alongside the IFIS quarterly consensus in `bar` rather than only the consensus; it did not change any size, because on this name the two bars agree in direction (consensus net income sits ¥1.0bn ABOVE the top of the company's own EPS range) and the 決算速報 wires demonstrably lead with 経常 vs consensus.
The file's note that the lean is no longer identical to the free control was read and recorded in `baseline_tension`; it did not move a number.
